scope: Full read of 11 assigned frozen backend files, all types and helper/operation families; include audit and other modules allocated separately.

validation.kind: Isolated correctness fixture, no performance campaign
validation.limitations: Engine-only fixtures exercise accepted consolidated fallback and NUL root; no public wrapper, upstream semantic suite, sanitizer, concurrency or performance campaign was rerun by this owner.

entries.name: write_column

entries.name: write_table

entries.name: write_null, write_element

entries.purpose: Translate policy or execute eager output
entries.costs: Concrete view forwarding; early gzip range check; file flush, partial failure documented

entries.name: H5Handle, H5Context

entries.name: dtype_of_h5, native_type, file_type, byte_order
entries.purpose: Translate native/file scalar representations

entries.name: read_text

entries.purpose: Project one record field into native memory
entries.costs: Boundary type handles and name strings; preserve raw boolean bytes for shared canonicalization

entries.name: StringPlan, StringBudgetExceeded, string_plan

entries.costs: Small plan; counts vector objects, per-string headers/pointers and 2x payload; no pre-read payload-size scan

entries.name: read_planned_strings, local DatasetReclaim
entries.purpose: Execute bounded fixed/VLEN string read

entries.name: Hdf5Backend::children

entries.name: Hdf5Backend::read_numeric, write_numeric
entries.purpose: Perform unprepared native-endian rectangle transfer

entries.name: Hdf5Backend::read_record_numeric, write_record_numeric
entries.purpose: Read/write projected numeric compound field
entries.costs: Projected datatype and rectangle per call; H5Pset_preserve for other members

entries.name: Hdf5Backend::read_strings, read_strings_bounded
entries.purpose: Read exact rectangle or admitted last-axis prefix

entries.name: Hdf5Backend::read_record_strings_bounded
entries.purpose: Read one projected text field with bounded retries
entries.costs: Field/type/rectangle acquisition; shared caller performs UTF-8 policy; raw/string staging counts

entries.name: Hdf5Backend::write_strings, write_record_strings
entries.purpose: Write variable/fixed strings or one projected record member

entries.name: Hdf5Backend::create_record
entries.purpose: Create supported flat compound record datatype

entries.name: Hdf5Backend::create_null, attributes
entries.purpose: Create true HDF5 null or replace named attributes

entries.purpose: Construct store or export without truncating its source

entries.name: CreateOptions

entries.name: relative_node, read_shape

entries.name: parse_type, dtype_name, serializer_endian

entries.name: parse_array

entries.name: chunk_key, sharding, raw_native, shard_spec, inner_shape

entries.name: flat, coordinates

entries.name: Store::children
entries.purpose: Combine local directories and consolidated child names

entries.name: scatter_numeric

findings.title: Reject empty and embedded-NUL Zarr roots before filesystem operations
findings.evidence: Engine NUL root reports file-buffer I/O failure rather than argument rejection; adapter destination preparation lacks the guard, but destructive behavior and public-wrapper error translation were not tested
findings.fix: Add one root-path validator before stat/canonicalization/prepare_destination; preserve source-overlap and record preflight
findings.migration: Private fix; valid path behavior unchanged
findings.acceptance: Public open/read/eager/backed writes reject embedded NUL with invalid_argument and leave intended/prefix destinations byte-identical

findings.title: Do not discard the only accepted consolidated metadata before structural operation admission
findings.evidence: Confirmed v2/v3 engine fallback accepts X then attributes throws and X disappears
findings.fix: Materialize supported consolidated-only metadata or reject writable mode/operation before any mutation; stage invalidation after required metadata capture
findings.migration: Choose a supported-write policy explicitly; read fallback remains
findings.acceptance: v2/v3 fallback child mutation either succeeds and reopens correctly or fails while original store hashes remain unchanged; cover attrs/create/rename/erase

findings.title: Remove row-local coordinate vectors and type-erased coordinate visitor
findings.evidence: Source-visible rank-vector allocations per copied row and std::function visitor; resize invokes visitor per cell
findings.fix: Use private concrete-callable coordinate traversal and direct mixed-radix offsets with reusable rank scratch; charge working metadata
findings.migration: Private only; no public module/template growth
findings.acceptance: Identical scalar/empty/rank3/edge/reversed/fill/gather outputs, scratch boundary behavior; compare allocations and public BMI hashes; speed only after bounded measurements

findings.title: Use static non-owning dtype tables and explicit cross-vocabulary mappings
findings.evidence: Source constructs owning name vectors each parse/name conversion; adapter ordinal casts require two enum declarations to stay aligned
findings.fix: Use constexpr string_view arrays and explicit Type/DType switch mappings with unsupported cases
findings.migration: No public API change; adding dtype must extend engine and format support intentionally
findings.acceptance: Round-trip every supported width/endian and reject unsupported dtype before destination preparation; allocation counts; consumer rebuild isolation

findings.title: Pack ordinary eager HDF5 strings without retaining all intermediate strings
findings.evidence: read_string_array retains vector<string> while constructing final packed bytes/offsets; record reader already packs directly
findings.fix: Consider a small private output-specific packed decoder/sink, retaining attribute/column vector outputs and reclaim guards
findings.migration: Private implementation only; eager result remains full materialization
findings.acceptance: Independent VLEN/fixed/Unicode/empty/scalar/filter/failure fixtures; UTF-8 and NUL policy unchanged; allocation/peak-byte comparison before memory improvement claim

findings.title: Reuse eager HDF5 tile coordinates and transfer objects
findings.evidence: write_tile reconstructs start/count/dataspaces each run; gathered dense write creates axes and copied tile each run
findings.fix: Give one private writer scratch state per dataset; reuse coordinates and typed tile storage without public templates
findings.migration: No public migration; preserve bounded row-fragment behavior
findings.acceptance: Contiguous/strided/gather/rank3/empty/scalar outputs and byte order; identical error boundaries; no numerical whole-array copy introduced

findings.title: Resolve HDF5 fixed-string padding divergence and share proven private UTF-8 invariant
findings.evidence: Eager NULLPAD trims trailing zeroes; backed readers cut at first NUL; multiple UTF-8 implementations duplicate rules
findings.fix: Establish fixed-string semantics with independent fixture; then share only validated primitive/padding rule, retaining boundary diagnostics and validation policy
findings.migration: Potential observable malformed/embedded-NUL interpretation requires explicit decision
findings.acceptance: Compare eager/backed attributes/ordinary/record fixed strings across NULLTERM/NULLPAD/SPACEPAD including interior NUL; malformed Unicode policy per Validation preserved

findings.title: Pass codec failure category explicitly
findings.evidence: Codec fail infers Failure from diagnostic words unsupported/unknown/working-memory/budget
findings.fix: Use explicit category or small named fail helpers; preserve public codes and paths intentionally
findings.migration: Private implementation; avoid changing stable error categories accidentally
findings.acceptance: Malformed payload, unsupported codec/config, capacity and I/O errors keep intended public ErrorCode/path after message edits

findings.title: Remove unused shard temporary owner and encoded workspace member
findings.evidence: TempFile is never instantiated; ShardWorkspace::encoded is only counted/reset and never populated
findings.fix: Delete TempFile and unused encoded member plus accounting/reset mentions
findings.migration: Private layout only; public interfaces unchanged
findings.acceptance: Compile all backend configurations; shard tests and scratch counter meanings unchanged except dead zero capacity

findings.title: Measure repeated codec-context construction before adding persistent state
findings.evidence: Reusable numeric buffers do not reuse ZSTD_CCtx/DCtx or zlib stream initialization; fallback reparses pipeline per inner chunk
findings.fix: If representative counts justify it, retain codec state in exclusively used prepared context or leave current simple code
findings.migration: Optional private design; do not create global cache, lock or scheduler
findings.acceptance: Bounded identical geometry count allocations/context calls and bytes; preserve failed-call recovery, codec settings, fork isolation, memory limits and build isolation
